caveats: All values are model estimates; observed=false and policy_grade=false.
Proxy facility capacity is a BC class-median fill, not an observed capacity; proxy shares are reported explicitly.
Class matching prohibits class feedstock mixing and forces province class streams to assigned facilities of the same class.
Provinces without a local assigned facility of a class use the national class fallback; this is not a transport or market model.
Conversion ratios are BC-anchored engineering proxies, not current measured facility yields.
Harvest residue is provincial and kept separate; it is not assigned to a facility and is not part of facility process residue.
The RSYC comparison is a screening check, not a calibration.
No transport, cost, revenue, capacity-expansion, tenure, AAC, or policy claim is made.
No UI or public OSeCAN surface is changed.

class_join.class_matching: strict; no class feedstock crosses facility classes
class_join.effective_conversion: product-chain province/class product or residue divided by product-chain province/class feedstock
class_join.fallback_rule: province-local assigned facilities of the same class first; otherwise national assigned facilities of the same class

method.allocation: per origin province and class, proportional to assignment-v2 assigned volume among same-class facilities
method.conversion: product-chain effective province/class product and residue ratios applied to facility feedstock
method.fallback: national same-class assigned facilities when no province-local assigned facility of that class exists
method.harvest_residue: province-level, separate from facility process residue
